English Language.question: ১) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) Put your sign here.
English Language.option2: খ) I got boarding and lodging.
English Language.option3: গ) My father is sick.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Quote this from memory.
English Language.exp:
অপশন, ‘ক’ তে sign এর স্থলে ‍Signature হবে।
খ তে, boarding and lodging এর স্থানে board and lodging হবে এবং
গ তে, sick এর স্থলে ill হবে।

English Language.question: ২) Choose the correct one-
English Language.option1: ক) Give me little butter please.
English Language.option2: খ) Give me few butter please.
English Language.option3: গ) Give me a little butter please.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Give me a few butter please.
English Language.exp: Uncountable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে little/a little এবং countable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে few/a few হবে। অতএব সঠিক বাক্য, Give me a little butter please.

English Language.question: ৩) He said to me, ‘Thank you’. Make it indirect speech.
English Language.option1: ক) He thanked me.
English Language.option2: খ) He had thanked me.
English Language.option3: গ) He told me that thank you.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He wished a thank to me.
English Language.exp: Direct Narration এ Thank you / Thanks / Congratulations! / Welcome থাকলে indirect Narration এ ‍said এর পরিবর্তে Thanked / congratulated / welcome বসে।

English Language.question: ৪) He pleases us. বাক্যটির passive form হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) We are pleased with him.
English Language.option2: খ) We were pleased with him.
English Language.option3: গ) We are pleased by him.
English Language.option4: ঘ) By whom can it be did.
English Language.exp:
He pleases us-বাক্যটিকে passive করতে, Subject (active এর objective এর subjective form) + be verb (am/is/are) + verb এর past participle form + preposition + object (active এর subject এর objective form).
যেহেতু passive voice এ pleased শব্দটি with preposition গ্রহন করে।

English Language.question: ৫) ‘Who can do it?’ - বাক্যটির passive form হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) By whom it can be done.
English Language.option2: খ) By whom it can be do.
English Language.option3: গ) By whom can it be done.
English Language.option4: ঘ) By whom can it be did.
English Language.exp:
যেহেতু এটি প্রশ্ন প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য। তাই, passive form এ subject ‘it’ এর আগে ‍auxiliary verb ‘can’ বসবে। আর passive form এর সারধারণ নিয়ম অনুযায়ী verb এর past participle (done) বসবে।
অর্থ্যাৎ সঠিক passive form টি হবে-
By whom can it be done.

English Language.question: ৬) ‘I will have a cup of tea’ my father said ‘because I’m not hungry.’ - Which one is the correct indirect speech?
English Language.option1: ক) My father said that the will having a cup of tea because he was not hungry.
English Language.option2: খ) My father said that he will have a cup of tea because he was not hungry.
English Language.option3: গ) My father said that he would have a cup of tea because he was not hungry.
English Language.option4: ঘ) My father said that he had a cup of tea because he was not hungry.
English Language.exp:
Direct speech এ reporting verb past tense (said) হওয়ায়-
Direct speech এর ‘will’ এবং ‘am’ indirect speech এ ‘would’ এবং ‘was’ এ রূপান্তরিত হবে।
অর্থ্যাৎ সঠিক indirect speech টি হবে-
My father said that he would have a cup of tea because he was not hungry.

English Language.question: ৭) He said to me, ‘you do not do your duty.’ বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) You told me that I do not do my duty.
English Language.option2: খ) You said to me that I did not do my duty.
English Language.option3: গ) You said to me that I do not do my duty.
English Language.option4: ঘ) You told me that I did not do my duty.
English Language.exp:
Said to থাকলে indirect speech এ told হবে এবং reporting verb এর tense কে অনুসরণ করে indirect speech এ পরিবর্তন আসবে।
এখানে তাই সঠিক indirect speech হবে – you told me that I did not do my duty.

English Language.question: ৮) Correct passive form of - ‘I have to do it’.
English Language.option1: ক) It has to be done by me.
English Language.option2: খ) It is to be done by me.
English Language.option3: গ) Let it be done by me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) It has to be done to me.
English Language.exp: Have to/ has to ব্যবহৃত active voice কে passive voice এ পরিবর্তনের ক্ষেত্রে – active voice এর object টি subject হবে + have to/ has to + be + vpp + by + subject এর object form বসবে। সুতরাং সঠিক passive বাক্যটি হবে – It has to be done by me.

English Language.question: ৯) The passive form of ‘I know him’ –
English Language.option1: ক) He was known to me.
English Language.option2: খ) He is known to me.
English Language.option3: গ) I was known to me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He known to me.
English Language.exp: Assertive sentence কে passive করতে হলে, প্রথমে, ০bject কে subject করতে হবে + Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb + verb এর p.p form by / to / with + sub কে obj। সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী He is known to me হবে।

English Language.question: ১০) ‘let him sing a song.’ বাক্যটির সঠিক পরিবর্তিত voice হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) Let a song sing by him.
English Language.option2: খ) Let a song be sung by him.
English Language.option3: গ) Let a song be sang by him.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Let a song sung by him.
English Language.exp:
Let যুক্ত imperative বাক্যের passive গঠন - let + object + be + v3 (past participle) + by + let পরবর্তী ব্যাক্তিবাচক objecet।
সুতরাং, ‘Let him sing a song.’- এর passive voice হবে ‘Let a song be sung by him.’

English Language.question: ১১) ‘Who will help you?’’ – বাক্যটির সঠিক পরিবর্তিত voice হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) By whom will you be helped?
English Language.option2: খ) By whom you will be helped?
English Language.option3: গ) By whom would you be helped?
English Language.option4: ঘ) By whom you would be helped?
English Language.exp:
Who দ্বারা শুরু হওয়া বাক্যের passive form এর শুরু হয় By Whom দ্বারা এরপর Will + obj + be + verb এর পর past particle + extension.
সুতরাং, নিয়ামানুযায়ী সঠিক বাক্য হবে-
By whom will you be helped?

English Language.question: ১২) He said to me, “May you have wealth.’’ – বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে?
English Language.option1: ক) He wished me that I might had wealth.
English Language.option2: খ) He wished me that I might have wealth.
English Language.option3: গ) He wished me that I should have wealth.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He said me that I might have wealth.
English Language.exp:
Optative sentence হলে indirect speech করার সময় ‍said এর পরিবর্তে wished / prayed হবে। এবং reporting verb অনুসারে অনুসারে tense এর পরিবর্তন হয়।
এখানে তাই সঠিক indirect speech হবে-
He wished me that I might have wealth.

English Language.question: ১৩) He asked me when the next letter would come. বাক্যের direct speech হচ্ছে-
English Language.option1: ক) He said to me, “When would the next letter come.’’
English Language.option2: খ) He asked me, “When will the next letter come?’’
English Language.option3: গ) He said to me, “When will the next letter come?”
English Language.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “When the next letter will come?”
English Language.exp:
Indirect speech এ asked এবং when থাকায় বুঝা যাচ্ছে, Reported speech একটি প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য।
প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যটিতে when থাকায় reporting verb টি ‍said হবে। আর সাথে object (me) থাকায় তার পূর্বে to বসবে।
অর্থ্যাৎ reporting verb এর পরে to বসবে। আর Reporting verb টি past tense এর হওয়ায় indirect speech এ থাকা would, direct speech এ will হবে।
অর্থ্যাৎ indirect speech টি হবে-
He said to me, “When will the next letter come?”

English Language.question: ১৪) Put the following sentence into indirect narration: ‘you had better not leave your room unlocked’ said my friends.
English Language.option1: ক) My friends asked me not to leave my room unlocked.
English Language.option2: খ) My friends reminded me to lock my room.
English Language.option3: গ) My friends advised me to lock my room.
English Language.option4: ঘ) My friends warned me not to leave my room unlocked.
English Language.exp:
প্রশ্নোক্ত direct speech টির ‍subject second person হওয়ায় এবং ‘had better’ থাকায় indirect speech এর গঠন হবে-
Subject + advise/advised + object + infinitive + বাকি অংশ।
এই গঠন অনুসারে অপশন (গ) ই সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question: ১৫) Which one is the correct passive form of ‘Who gave you this pen.’?
English Language.option1: ক) By whom have you been given this pen?
English Language.option2: খ) By Whom were you got this pen?
English Language.option3: গ) By whom were you given this pen?
English Language.option4: ঘ) By whom was you given this pen?
English Language.exp:
Who দ্বারা শুরু হওয়া বাক্যের passive form এর শুরু হয় By whom দ্বারা এরপর auxiliary verb + sub + verb এর past participle + extension.
সুতরাং নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক বাক্য হবে - By whom were you given this pen?

English Language.question: ১৬) He said, “I have been working since sunrise.” Make it indirect speech.
English Language.option1: ক) He said he had been working since sunrise.
English Language.option2: খ) He said he has worked for sunrise.
English Language.option3: গ) He said that he has been working since sunrise.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He said that he is working.
English Language.exp:
অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে সঠিক উত্তর- He said he had been working since sunrise.
কারণ, indirect speech এ say/says/said এবং tell/told + object এর পরে that ব্যবহার না করলেও চলে। তবে অন্য সকল verb (boast, explain, exclaim etc ) এর পরে অবশ্যই ‘that’ ব্যবহার করতে হবে।

English Language.question: ১৭) He taught me to read English বাক্যটির passive form হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) I was taught by him to read English.
English Language.option2: খ) I have been taught by him to read English.
English Language.option3: গ) Both a + b
English Language.option4: ঘ) None
English Language.exp: Voice change এর সাধারণ নিয়ম অনুসারে ব্যক্তিবাচক object (me) কে passive voice এর subject (i) তে রূপান্তর করা হয়েছে। আবার যেহেতু past indefinite tense এর তাই passive voice এ auxiliary verb হিসেবে was ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

English Language.question: ১৮) I am writing a letter – বাক্যটির সঠিক পরিবর্তিত voice হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) A letter is written be me.
English Language.option2: খ) A letter was written by me.
English Language.option3: গ) A letter was being written by me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) A letter is being written by me.
English Language.exp:
Present continuous tense এর Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম : object টির subjective form + am being / is being / are being + মূল verb এর past participle + by + subject এর objective form.
সুতরাং সঠিক passive form হবে - A letter is being written by me.

English Language.question: ১৯) Do not hate the poor. বাক্যটির সঠিক পরিবর্তিত voice হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) Let not the poor be hated.
English Language.option2: খ) Let the poor not be hated.
English Language.option3: গ) Let not the poor hate.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Let poor not be hate.
English Language.exp: No explanation added.

English Language.question: ২০) Raju said to me, ‘I was ill’ বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
English Language.option1: ক) Raju said to me that he was ill.
English Language.option2: খ) Raju told me that he had been ill.
English Language.option3: গ) Raju told me that I had been ill.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Raju told me that he has been ill.
English Language.exp: Reporting verb এবং Reported speech উভয়েই past indefinite tense হলে indirect speech এর বেলায় Reported speech কে past perfect করতে হয়্। সুতরাং, অপশন খ হবে সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question: ২১) নিচের কোন বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ?
English Language.option1: ক) I felt his pulse.
English Language.option2: খ) I found his pulse.
English Language.option3: গ) I examined his pulse.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I saw his pulse.
English Language.exp:
Feel somebody’s pulse অর্থ হাতের কবজির ধমনিতে হাত রেখে নাড়িস্পন্দনের হার গণনা করা।
Check / take / feel someone’s pulse : to measure how fast someone’s heart is beating.

English Language.question: ২২) Identify the correct Sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) She had faith and hopes for the future.
English Language.option2: খ) She had faith in and hopes for the future.
English Language.option3: গ) She had faith and hopes in the future.
English Language.option4: ঘ) She had faith and hope in future.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (খ) এর বাক্যটি- She had faith in and hopes for the future সঠিক।
অন্যান্য অপশনগুলোতে preposition এর ভুল ব্যবহার রয়েছে।
Faith in – কোন কিছুতে বিশ্বাস রাখা।
Hope for – কোন বিষয়ে আশা প্রকাশ করা।

English Language.question: ২৩) নিচের কোন বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ?
English Language.option1: ক) Good night, how are you?
English Language.option2: খ) Ali took admission into that college.
English Language.option3: গ) He always speaks the truth.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He asked me where did I go.
English Language.exp:
Good night বিদায় সম্বোধক, তাই অপশন ‘ক’ অশুদ্ধ বাক্য।
কলেজে ভর্তি হওয়া বুঝাতে got admission হবে, তাই অপশন ‘খ’ অশুদ্ধ।
‘Where did I’ এর পরিবর্তে ‘where I’ হলে অপশন ‘গ’ এর বাক্যটি সঠিক হত।
ইংরেজি ব্যাকরণের নিয়ামানুসারে অপশন ‘ঘ’ সঠিক।

English Language.question: ২৪) Which sentence is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) He will avail the opportunity.
English Language.option2: খ) I should take leave of you.
English Language.option3: গ) I have seen two deers.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Television is a wonderful discovery.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (খ) সঠিক। কারণ, বিদায় নেয়া অর্থে take leave of ব্যবহৃত হয়।
এছাড়া অপশন ক-তে avail of, গ-তে deer এবং ঘ-তে invention হলে বাক্যগুলো শুদ্ধ হতো।

English Language.question: ২৫) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) He was hunged for murder.
English Language.option2: খ) He has been hunging for murder.
English Language.option3: গ) He was hanged for murder.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He has been hunged for murder.
English Language.exp:
Hang – ফাঁসি দেওয়া। এর past form হচ্ছে hanged।
সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - He was hanged for murder.

English Language.question: ২৬) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) Death is preferable than dishonor.
English Language.option2: খ) Death is more preferable than dishonor.
English Language.option3: গ) Death is preferable then dishonor.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Death is preferable to dishonor.
English Language.exp:
Preferable এর সাথে to হয় এবং preferable একটি comparative quantifier বলে এর আগে more ব্যবহার হয় না।
যেমন – ‍A logical solution is preferable to war.

English Language.question: ২৭) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) The bus company will compensate us for the loss.
English Language.option2: খ) The bus company will compensate us form the loss.
English Language.option3: গ) The bus company will compensate us the loss.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The bus company will compensate us our loss.
English Language.exp: Compensate somebody for something অর্থ কাউকে কোনকিছুর জন্য ক্ষতিপূরণ দেওয়া। অতএব সঠিক বাক্য হবে - The bus company will compensate us for the loss.

English Language.question: ২৮) Choose the correct one.
English Language.option1: ক) The boy was too clever not to missing the point.
English Language.option2: খ) The boy was too clever not too miss the point.
English Language.option3: গ) The boy was too clever to miss the point.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The boy were clever enough to miss the point.
English Language.exp: Too + adj + to + v1 হলো সঠিক sequence. সে অনুযায়ী অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে সঠিক উত্তর হবে - The boy was too clever to miss the point.

English Language.question: ২৯) Which of the following sentence is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) Your taste is worse then mine.
English Language.option2: খ) Your taste is more worse then mine.
English Language.option3: গ) Your taste is worse than mine.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Your taste is worser than mine.
English Language.exp: Bad এর comparative degree হচ্ছে worse এবং তুলনা বুঝাতে than ব্যবহার করা হয়। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য হচ্ছে- Your taste is worse than mine.

English Language.question: ৩০) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) The roads of Dhaka are more wider than that of Barishal.
English Language.option2: খ) The roads of Dhaka is wider than those of Barishal.
English Language.option3: গ) The roads of Dhaka are wider than those of Barishal.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The roads of Dhaka is wider then those of Barishal.
English Language.exp:
অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে সঠিক উত্তর হবে - The roads of Dhaka are wider than those of Barishal.
কারণ, এই বাক্যে ঢাকার রাস্তাগুলোর সাথে বরিশালের রাস্তাগুলোর তুলনা বুঝাচ্ছে। আর Roads হলো plural তাই verb ও হবে plural form এ।

English Language.question: ৩১) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) One of my friends are a lawyer.
English Language.option2: খ) One of my friends is a lawyer.
English Language.option3: গ) One of my friend is a lawyer.
English Language.option4: ঘ) One of my friends are lawyer.
English Language.exp: One of + plural noun + singular verb হচ্ছে সঠিক ‍sequence। সুতরাং, সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে – one of my friends is a lawyer.

English Language.question: ৩২) Which one is correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) The old man died by over eating.
English Language.option2: খ) The old man died in over eating.
English Language.option3: গ) The old man died from over eating.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The old man died for over eating.
English Language.exp:
সাধারণত, die of (disease- he died of cholera.
Die from (effect) : He died from snake bite/overeating.
Die in (accident) : He died in a train accident.

English Language.question: ৩৩) Choose the correct sentence.
English Language.option1: ক) There is no place for doubt in it.
English Language.option2: খ) There is no misunderstanding in it.
English Language.option3: গ) There is no suspension in it.
English Language.option4: ঘ) There is no room for doubt in it.
English Language.exp: ফাঁকা স্থান, সম্ভাবনা, সুযোগ, অবকাশ (বিশেষ উদ্দেশ্যে ব্যবহারের জন্য) অর্থে room ব্যবহৃত হয়। সঠিক বাক্যটি হচ্ছে - There is no room for doubt in it.

English Language.question: ৩৪) Choose the correct sentence.
English Language.option1: ক) We packed our luggages.
English Language.option2: খ) Honey is too sweet.
English Language.option3: গ) Your informations is false.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Listen to my advice.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (ক) তে, luggages এর স্থানে luggage হবে।
(খ) তে, too এর স্থলে very হবে এবং
(গ) তে, informations এর পরিবর্তে information হবে। কারণ, luggage, information, advice এর uncountable noun তাই এদের plural হয় না।

English Language.question: ৩৫) Which one is correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) He copied the answer word by word.
English Language.option2: খ) He copied the answer word with word.
English Language.option3: গ) He copied the answer word for word.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He copied the answer word in word.
English Language.exp: Word for word means using exactly the same words. অর্থ্যাৎ একদম হুবহু শব্দ ব্যবহার করা।

English Language.question: ৩৬) Choose the incorrect one.
English Language.option1: ক) The colour of her eyes is brown.
English Language.option2: খ) The players in the field are strong.
English Language.option3: গ) Fifty miles is a long way.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He ran fast lest he miss the bus.
English Language.exp: অপশন (ঘ)-এ should miss হবে কারণ, lest + should/might + base form হবে। বাকি তিনটি সঠিক বাক্য।

English Language.question: ৩৭) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) I have an urgent business.
English Language.option2: খ) Suffice so say she did very well.
English Language.option3: গ) We get up at dawn.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The reason for success are known to me.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (ক) তে, a piece of urgent business হবে।
(খ) তে, suffice it to say হবে He copied the answer word by word.
এবং (ঘ) তে, are এর স্থলে is হয়।

English Language.question: ৩৮) Which one below is a correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) Sajib asked that how did he do.
English Language.option2: খ) The united states are a powerful country.
English Language.option3: গ) My son is ill this week.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The game drew numerous spectators.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (ক) তে asked how did হবে। কারণ, dependent clause টি assertive sentence এ হয়।
(খ) তে, is হবে। কারণ দেশের নাম দেখতে plural হলেও সর্বদা singular verb গ্রহণ করে।
(গ) তে, is এর স্থলে has been হবে।

English Language.question: ৩৯) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) One of my friends are a lawyer.
English Language.option2: খ) It rained three days.
English Language.option3: গ) Do you have a complain against me?
English Language.option4: ঘ) You are proud of Bangladesh.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (ক) তে, are এর স্থলে is হবে। কারণ, one of + plural noun + singular verb।
অপশন (খ) তে, rained এর স্থলে has been raining হবে এবং
(গ) তে, complain (verb) এর স্থলে complaint (noun) হবে। ‍Article এর পরে noun বসে।

English Language.question: ৪০) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) Dog is a faithful animal.
English Language.option2: খ) Tell me where are you going.
English Language.option3: গ) I saw his pulse.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He cannot pronounce the word.
English Language.exp:
অপশন (ক) তে, A dog/ The dog is a faithful animal. অথবা Dogs are faithful animals হবে।
(খ) তে হবে, Tell me where you are going এবং
(গ) তে, felt হবে। কারণ নাড়ি দেখা অর্থে feel one’s pulse হয়।

English Language.question: ৪১) Choose the correct sentence.
English Language.option1: ক) We drive to the grocery store this afternoon.
English Language.option2: খ) We drove to the grocery store this afternoon.
English Language.option3: গ) We drives to the grocery store this afternoon.
English Language.option4: ঘ) We driven to the grocery store this afternoon.
English Language.exp: বাক্যটিতে this afternoon থাকায় তা past indefinite tense হবে। তাই, ‘We drove to the grocery store this afternoon.’ সঠিক বাক্য।

English Language.question: ৪২) Choose the correct sentence.
English Language.option1: ক) It had been raining all day today.
English Language.option2: খ) It was raining all day today.
English Language.option3: গ) It rains all day today.
English Language.option4: ঘ) It has been raining all day today.
English Language.exp: বাক্যে All day today থাকায় present perfect continuous tense হবে। সুতরাং It has been raining all day today.-বাক্যটি সঠিক।

English Language.question: ৪৩) Which one is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) The chair is made by wood.
English Language.option2: খ) The chair is made in wood.
English Language.option3: গ) The chair is made from wood.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The chair is made of wood.
English Language.exp: উৎপাদন প্রক্রিয়ার পর সৃষ্ট বস্তুতে উপাদান পরিবর্তিত থাকলে অর্থ্যাৎ চোখে দেখে উপাদান সনাক্ত করতে পারলে made এর পর of বসে। কিন্তু চোখে দেখে সনাক্ত করতে না পারলে made এর পরে from বসে। যেমন- The paper is made from wood.

English Language.question: ৪৪) Choose the correct one.
English Language.option1: ক) I have a bone to pick on you.
English Language.option2: খ) I have a bone to pick for you.
English Language.option3: গ) I have a bone to pick at you.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I have a bone to pick with you.
English Language.exp: ‘To have a bone to pick with somebody’- হলো একটি phrase. যার অর্থ তর্ক বা নালিশ করার মতো কোন ব্যাপার থাকা।

English Language.question: ৪৫) The correct Sentence of the followings-
English Language.option1: ক) A new cabinet has been sworn in Barishal.
English Language.option2: খ) A new cabinet has been sworn in in Barishal.
English Language.option3: গ) A new cabinet has been sworn by in Barishal.
English Language.option4: ঘ) A new cabinet has sworn in Barishal.
English Language.exp:
Swear in শপথ গ্রহন করা এবং স্থানের নামের পূর্বে in হবে। আবার শপথ কাজটি প্রধান বিচারপতি করান, cabinet নিজে করে না। তাই বাক্যটি passive voice হবে।
সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য-
A new cabinet has been sworn in in Barishal.

English Language.question: ৪৬) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) Let he and you be witnesses.
English Language.option2: খ) Let you and he be witnesses.
English Language.option3: গ) Let you and him be witnesses.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Let your and he be witness.
English Language.exp: Let শব্দটির পর pronoun এর objective form বসে। এই ধরনের sentence এ প্রথমে 2<sup>nd</sup>, 3<sup>rd</sup> এবং সবশেষে 1<sup>st</sup> person বসে।

English Language.question: ৪৭) Which one of the following is a correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) He insisted her to go there.
English Language.option2: খ) He did not insist her to go there.
English Language.option3: গ) He insist her going there.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He insisted on her going there.
English Language.exp: Insist এর পর preposition ‘on’ হবে।

English Language.question: ৪৮) The incorrect sentence is-
English Language.option1: ক) She doesn’t attend class regularly.
English Language.option2: খ) They don’t attend class regularly.
English Language.option3: গ) She don’t attend class regularly.
English Language.option4: ঘ) She does attend class regularly.
English Language.exp:
অপশন ‘গ’ এর বাক্যটি গঠনগতভাবে ভুল।
বাক্যটির সঠিক গঠন হবে - She doesn’t attend class regularly. অন্য তিনটি বাক্য সঠিক।

English Language.question: ৪৯) Which of the following is correct?
English Language.option1: ক) I thought be loves me.
English Language.option2: খ) I thought he loved me.
English Language.option3: গ) I thought he will love me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I thought he may love me.
English Language.exp: Main clause টি past tense আছে তাই subordinate clause টিও past হবে।

English Language.question: ৫০) Which one is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) Karim is used to worked hard.
English Language.option2: খ) Karim is used to working hard.
English Language.option3: গ) Karim is used to hard working.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Karim used to working hard.
English Language.exp:
Be used to + verb + ing এবং used to + v1 হলো সঠিক sequence। Be used to দ্বারা বর্তমান সময়ের অভ্যস্ততা বুঝায় আর used to দ্বারা অতীতের অভ্যাস।
সুতরাং, structure অনুযায়ী সঠিক ‍sentence - Karim is used to working hard.
